# Legendary modules in public events

![Legendary modules in public events](/uploads/398_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

With the Milepost Zero update on September 3rd, 2024, the legendary cores were removed from the game. Previously, these were available as rewards at public events. Now there are legendary modules instead. We now need more modules for the new legendary production and we now get significantly more through the events. In addition, the **weight of the modules has been changed from 0.25 to 0.15** (with Messi Perk even only 0.04) and the modules now count as **scrap** (i.e. can be placed in the **recycling box**). If you don't have Fallout 1st, you can simply carry the modules with you. **The modules cannot be discarded and you will not lose them if you die in the game.**

## Public events with legendary modules

### Events with 5 legendary modules

- Cryptic
- A colossal problem
- Free range (if all Brahmins survive)
- Project Paradise (if all animals survive)

## Tip: Farm cryptically

If you want to farm legendary modules very efficiently and quickly and have a small team of players, you can farm the “Cryptic” event very well.

To start Cryptic, you will need an **Aggressotron Recall Keycard**, which you can purchase from all merchants at train stations. After purchase, it must be crafted at a **crafting workbench** with Fluxen. You can only buy the key cards once you have completed the "Van Lowe" quest**. Read the posters at the train stations with the Sheepsquatch and the inscription “Sheepsquatch ate my brother”.

You start the event at the “Pylon Ambush” in Ash Heap (southeast of Rusty Pick). The event has a cooldown of around 3 hours and is therefore not always guaranteed to start on public servers.

To farm cryptically with Fallout 1st (private server), follow these steps:

- Form a team with fellow players who have a number of Aggressotron Recall Key Cards ready
- One of you starts a private server (Fallout 1st)
(Make sure that the others can join you. So either form a team in the main menu or set the server to "Friends")
- Gather at the ambush pylon
- Starts the event
- Receive **5 Legendary Modules** upon completion
- Now you leave this server
- Another player from your team starts a new private server
- You all join together again and start the event again
- So you can take turns privately
